blocks.text: What shared hosting actually gives you

content.text: On shared hosting, your website runs on a server shared with other websites, and ZedgeHost manages that server for you. You work through cPanel: create email accounts, install WordPress in one click, manage files and databases, and check backups. You never touch the server itself, which is why shared hosting is the simplest way to get a website online. Every shared and WordPress plan includes a free SSL certificate, free cPanel, daily backups, free website migration and 24/7 support, with a 30-day money-back guarantee. For a full breakdown of what hosting costs in Pakistan, see
how much web hosting costs in Pakistan

Enterprise is currently Rs 4,999 per year, reduced from Rs 9,999. WordPress hosting uses the same four plans and prices as shared hosting, with one-click WordPress installs. If your site grows past what shared hosting handles,
cloud hosting from Rs 9,999 per year
is the middle step before a server of your own.

blocks.text: What VPS hosting actually gives you

content.text: On a VPS, you get your own virtual server with resources reserved for you alone: a set amount of CPU, RAM, storage and data transfer that no other customer can use. You get full root access, a server management panel and VNC access, and you choose the server location (New Jersey, Los Angeles or Dallas) and the operating system (AlmaLinux, Ubuntu, Debian, or an empty disk) at checkout. That control is the whole point of a VPS: you install what you need, configure it your way, and host several websites or applications on one server.

VPS plans are billed monthly, with a yearly option at checkout, and every plan includes an up to 10 Gbps shared port. The trade-off is responsibility: with root access comes server management, so a VPS suits buyers who are comfortable configuring a server, or who have a developer to do it. See the full
VPS hosting plans
before you decide.

blocks.text: A small business website, blog or portfolio

content.text: Choose shared hosting. A company profile, a catalogue with photos, an enquiry form and email on your own domain all fit comfortably on a Starter or Standard plan.

blocks.text: A growing online store or several websites

content.text: Choose a VPS when orders and traffic grow, or when you host several websites that need guaranteed resources. A store doing steady daily orders, a site with heavy images or video, or five or ten client sites on one account all point toward
VPS hosting from Rs 1,699 per month
. If you want more room without managing a server yourself,
cloud hosting from Rs 9,999 per year
sits in between.

blocks.text: An agency or developer hosting client sites

content.text: Choose a VPS. Each client site gets dedicated resources, and you keep full control of the server: the operating system, the software, the security setup and the backups. Start with VPS Basic and scale up only when the sites you host demand it. If you are comparing prices first, see

blocks.text: How to decide in five steps

items.text: One small website fits shared hosting. Several websites, a busy store or full server control points toward a VPS.
Compare the full price, not the headline.
Shared hosting is billed per year and VPS per month, so compare the same period: Rs 1,499 per year against Rs 1,699 per month is a real difference, not a small one. Confirm the renewal price too.
Check the resources, not just the price.
Count the websites, storage and traffic you actually need. A plan that is too small costs more in moves and upgrades than the saving was worth.
If you want the host to manage the server, stay on shared hosting with cPanel. If you want root access and your own configuration, a VPS is the right tool.
A 30-day money-back guarantee means you can try the service and leave if it does not fit, and free migration means you can move from shared to VPS later without rebuilding your site.
